llm.summary: This is a Chinese self-reflection coaching skill with emotionally probing prompts, but it does not install code, use tools, access data, persist changes, or hide unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local filesystem, credential, network, account, browser, or mutation authority; its behavior is limited to conversational guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown content only. No executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or tool registration behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad for self-help contexts and the skill lacks explicit consent, opt-out, or crisis-boundary framing before deep introspection. This is a user-experience and safety note, not evidence of malicious or hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, memory-writing instruction, background worker, scheduled task, privilege escalation, or tool hijacking was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently support the stated purpose: a Dan Koe-style identity-shift exercise that asks sequential reflective questions and produces a gamified life plan. Some prompts are emotionally intense, but that is tied to the declared coaching purpose rather than a hidden capability.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want a Chinese-language, direct, emotionally probing identity-reflection workflow. Users who are in crisis, dealing with severe anxiety or depression, or uncomfortable with shame/regret-style prompts should avoid or pause the exercise and seek appropriate human support. Publishers should add language preference handling, opt-out wording, and mental-health/crisis boundaries.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation criteria are real in the artifact and could cause the method to appear in general life-planning or self-understanding requests. Because the skill has no external authority or hidden behavior, this supports cautionary guidance rather than Review escalation.
[SQP-2] expected: The emotionally challenging prompts about pain, regret, abandonment, identity, anger, jealousy, and anxiety are present and central to the coaching method. The missing safety framing is a meaningful usability concern, but it is disclosed in the artifact's purpose and does not indicate malicious behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The artifacts are almost entirely Chinese and do not negotiate language preference. This should be disclosed to users or improved, but it is visible and consistent with the skill presentation rather than deceptive.
[A.I.G SARIF] expected: The static security scan reported no T01-T09 results, consistent with inspection showing Markdown-only conversational instructions and no executable or privileged behavior.
